summary: Frontend-only validation of in-app customer account deletion (Apple 5.1.1(v)/nFADP) on the preview sandbox. All 6 scenarios of the review request PASSED end-to-end (10/10 UI assertions). FR and DE modals render the exact expected texts, wrong password produces 'Mot de passe incorrect' toast while the modal stays open and the user stays logged in, correct password triggers 'Votre compte a été supprimé'/'Ihr Konto wurde gelöscht' toast, logs the user out and re-login attempts with the deleted phone return 'Téléphone ou mot de passe incorrect'. The 'Supprimer' / 'Löschen' confirm button is correctly disabled (aria-disabled='true') while the password field is empty. Regression: sandbox customer 079 555 12 34 / secret123 still logs in as 'Test Client' and logs out; staff manager 'Preview-Manager-2026!' still lands on /staff. Language reset back to FR at the end. No production endpoint contacted (all traffic via preview.emergentagent.com). No orders placed.
critical_code_review_comments: account/index.tsx DeleteAccount is clean: modal state resets on close, confirm disabled while password empty, deleteAccount() surfaces server error via toast without closing the modal (so user can retry), success clears state then triggers logout+router.back().
i18n keys for FR and DE match the expected strings from the review request exactly (deleteAccountTitle, deleteAccountConfirm, accountDeleted).
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted two throwaway customer accounts during the run: 079 123 45 67 (FR flow) and 079 123 45 68 (DE flow), both with password Delete-Me-2026!. Both are now anonymised/deleted server-side, so the sandbox is left clean. Sandbox customer 079 555 12 34 and staff passwords untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://hallo-magic-test.preview.emergentagent.com. Selectors: Field renders testID directly on the TextInput (no ' input' suffix needed). Toast auto-dismisses in ~2600ms – capture text early. account-delete-confirm uses aria-disabled='true' when disabled, absent when enabled. Language switcher on the /more (Plus) tab: lang-row-fr / lang-row-de. Staff login /staff/login uses staff-password-input + staff-pin-submit; Preview-Manager-2026! logs in and redirects to /staff. Do NOT call emergent.host and do NOT delete the fixed sandbox user 079 555 12 34.
rca_of_issue: N/A – this run validated an implemented feature, not a bug. Observed exact toast texts: 'Mot de passe incorrect' (wrong pwd), 'Votre compte a été supprimé' (FR success), 'Ihr Konto wurde gelöscht' (DE success), 'Téléphone ou mot de passe incorrect' (re-login after deletion). Confirm button label was 'Supprimer' in FR and 'Löschen' in DE.
